newsitem.title: FRANCE: EUROBANK TO BUY RETAIL BANKING OF CREDIT LYONNAIS/GREECE.
newsitem.headline: EUROBANK TO BUY RETAIL BANKING OF CREDIT LYONNAIS/GREECE.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Greece, an affiliate of Credit Lyonnais , concluded on Wednesday an agreement in principle with Euromerchant Bank to sell its retail banking, Credit Lyonnais said in a statement.
The price of the transaction was not disclosed, it said.
Credit Lyonnais has a 96.4 percent stake in Credit Lyonnais Greece which posted a net profit of 70 million French francs in 1996, it said.
Credit Lyonnais Greece has been operating in Greece since 1977 as a representative branch and an affiliate since 1981, it added.
Eurobank was founded in 1990 and is the third largest private bank in Greece, it added.
Eurobank bought Interbank from Banque Worms in 1996, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
